description: Captured thirty-minute seed42 physical world. Three living floor-1 NPCs never discovered a reachable annex despite marking its doorway explored. Original personal access, HP, furniture, zombies, puzzle state and conceptual work are retained. Original learner excluded, global event ring cleared, NPC activity-only history trimmed. Counterfactual replay, not a new complete run.
